name: yukibana-pack-go
description: Yukibana Go pack: a go/types language server and Go's own compiler and linker, compiled to WebAssembly, building for WASI and for x86-64, AArch64 and RISC-V Linux (run under the C/C++ pack's QEMU-Wasm). build.sh builds it; this file holds the bundler, the WASI host and the test's browser driver.
